new_warnings.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
new_warnings.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
new_warnings.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.
new_warnings.detail: Function `public.get_my_event_export_rows(p_event_id uuid)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/get_my_event_export_rows`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
